Ensemble of Hope#475.src: Talk to Sui outside the newspaper shop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Ensemble of Hope#475.dst: [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] の新聞店の外で Sui と話す。

Ensemble of Hope#476.src: I don't know what I expected... ugh!! I just thought maybe, they could...
Ensemble of Hope#476.dst: 何を期待してたんだろ…もう！！ただ、もしかしたらって…
Ensemble of Hope#476.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#477.src: Whatever. Rex was right, after all. They're not worth-
Ensemble of Hope#477.dst: まあいい。結局 Rex が正しかった。あいつらに価値なんて―
Ensemble of Hope#477.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#481.src: Aaah, sorrysorrysorry! I couldn't stop in time, I-
Ensemble of Hope#481.dst: ああっ、ごめんごめんごめん！止まれなくて、私―
Ensemble of Hope#481.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Ensemble of Hope#482.src: No, nononono, that's not what- Sorry, sorry!! That was an accident, I promise!
Ensemble of Hope#482.dst: 違う、違う違う、そうじゃなくて―ごめん、ごめん！！事故なの、本当に！
Ensemble of Hope#482.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Ensemble of Hope#483.src: Ugf...y-yeah. Sorry, I just, I had to catch up to you, I got running, and-
Ensemble of Hope#483.dst: うぐ…う、うん。ごめん、ただ、追いつかなきゃって、走り出して、それで―
Ensemble of Hope#483.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Ensemble of Hope#484.src: Look, I... A-anything. I want to help. Please, please let me help!
Ensemble of Hope#484.dst: 聞いて、私…な、何でもいい。手伝いたいの。お願い、お願いだから手伝わせて！
Ensemble of Hope#484.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Ensemble of Hope#485.src: ...really? You didn't stand up for us at the meeting, but...
Ensemble of Hope#485.dst: …本当に？会合では味方してくれなかったのに…
Ensemble of Hope#485.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#486.src: What's different with you? Why do you want to help, when- when nobody else will!!
Ensemble of Hope#486.dst: あなたは何が違うの？どうして手伝いたいの、誰も―誰も手伝ってくれないのに！！
Ensemble of Hope#486.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#487.src: ...I... It's... Look, when I stumbled onto them, the Blossom, I thought- I always thought it'd be...more than...that.
Ensemble of Hope#487.dst: …私…それは…あのね、刃の花にたまたま出会った時、私―ずっと思ってたの…もっと…何かだって。
Ensemble of Hope#487.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Ensemble of Hope#488.src: {p} gets a lot of news. You can't escape the gossip, the rumors. And, I've always wanted to try and help people. I'm not blind that...that I have it easy here.
Ensemble of Hope#488.dst: {p} にはたくさんニュースが入ってくる。噂話からは逃げられない。それに、ずっと人の助けになりたかったの。私がここで…恵まれてるのはわかってる。
Ensemble of Hope#488.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Ensemble of Hope#489.src: I want to do something, for people who aren't so lucky, but- But- I'm aware, that's all I am! I, I'm not smart, I'm not strong, I'm not sneaky, or, or anything!
Ensemble of Hope#489.dst: 恵まれない人たちのために何かしたい、でも―でも―自覚してるの、私はそれだけ！頭もよくない、強くない、隠密もできない、何も！
Ensemble of Hope#489.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Ensemble of Hope#490.src: I thought that, that maybe, the Blossom would give me some kind of...direction. Teach me, point me at something I could do, or handle, but-
Ensemble of Hope#490.dst: もしかしたら、刃の花が何か…方向を示してくれるかもって思った。教えて、私にできることを指し示してくれるかもって、でも―
Ensemble of Hope#490.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Ensemble of Hope#491.src: It's just...more news! Hearing that it's even worse than I knew! And they're all in the same boat- They don't know what to do, and they're too scared to let anyone try!
Ensemble of Hope#491.dst: ただの…ニュースが増えるだけ！思ってたよりもっとひどいって聞かされるだけ！みんな同じ立場で―どうすればいいかわからなくて、誰かが試すのも怖がってる！
Ensemble of Hope#491.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Ensemble of Hope#492.src: I can barely sleep, or, or keep food down, or get through the day without getting completely derailed thinking about other people suffering and how I'm not doing anything to stop it!
Ensemble of Hope#492.dst: ほとんど眠れないし、食べても戻しちゃうし、誰かが苦しんでるのに私は何もしてないって考えると、一日だってまともに過ごせないの！
Ensemble of Hope#492.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Ensemble of Hope#494.src: If you interrupt I'm not gonna be able to keep talking please shut up til I'm done.
Ensemble of Hope#494.dst: 話を遮られたら続けられなくなるから終わるまでお願い黙ってて。
Ensemble of Hope#494.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Ensemble of Hope#495.src: All I've got is showing up. Being here. But that's not enough, that's not...anything! It's more than most people do, sure, but what does that matter to, to, to...
Ensemble of Hope#495.dst: 私にできるのは顔を出すことだけ。ここにいるだけ。でもそれじゃ足りない、何にも…ならない！大半の人よりはましかもしれない、でもそれが何になるの、何に…
Ensemble of Hope#495.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Ensemble of Hope#496.src: To some...Agricultural District man who can't feed himself? Or some Auburn family that gets broken up cause their mom accidentally badmouths the Queen and gets jailed?
Ensemble of Hope#496.dst: 自分も食べていけない…農業区の男の人にとって？女王の悪口をうっかり言ったお母さんが投獄されて、ばらばらになる Auburn の家族にとって？
Ensemble of Hope#496.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Ensemble of Hope#497.src: But you! You're getting out there, you're taking the risks! You've got plans, and direction, and, and I've got to do something or else I'll go crazy!
Ensemble of Hope#497.dst: でもあなたたちは！外に出て、危険を冒してる！計画も方向もある、それに、それに私も何かしないと、おかしくなっちゃう！
Ensemble of Hope#497.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Ensemble of Hope#498.src: So...please. Tell me...tell me what I can do. Let me be useful, for once in my stupid freaking life, instead of sitting here like a depressed lump in the lap of luxury.
Ensemble of Hope#498.dst: だから…お願い。教えて…私に何ができるか教えて。このしょうもない人生で一度くらい役に立たせて。贅沢の中で落ち込んだ塊みたいに座ってるんじゃなくて。
Ensemble of Hope#498.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Ensemble of Hope#499.src: ...I had no idea this was such a burden on you, Rose. I knew you were worried, but...I didn't realize how much.
Ensemble of Hope#499.dst: …そんなに重荷だったなんて知らなかった、Rose。心配してるのは知ってたけど…ここまでとは。
Ensemble of Hope#499.speaker: Wilted Camellia

Ensemble of Hope#500.src: It...it's... It's been like this for years. I don't know how much more I can handle, and I feel so selfish for saying that, when I'm...here.
Ensemble of Hope#500.dst: も…もう…何年もこうなの。あとどれだけ耐えられるかわからないし、ここにいる私が…そう言うのは、すごく身勝手に思える。
Ensemble of Hope#500.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Ensemble of Hope#503.src: Well... um. We- we have big plans, and... with your ties to the papers, maybe we can make it happen.
Ensemble of Hope#503.dst: じゃあ…えっと。私―私たちには大きな計画があって…新聞とつながりのあるあなたなら、実現できるかも。
Ensemble of Hope#503.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#504.src: We're going to kill Sovereign Majin, and topple the Queen's hold on Fruma.
Ensemble of Hope#504.dst: 君主 Majin を殺して、Fruma に対する女王の支配を崩すの。
Ensemble of Hope#504.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#506.src: So- so we need you to spread the word. Do whatever you can to make it big news, and... and get everyone here in an uproar about it at the festival tomorrow.
Ensemble of Hope#506.dst: だ、だからその話を広めてほしい。できる限り大ニュースにして…明日の祭りで、ここのみんなを騒がせて。
Ensemble of Hope#506.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#507.src: We, um. We need that distraction to pull it off. So... are you up for it?
Ensemble of Hope#507.dst: 私たち、えっと。成功させるにはその陽動が必要なの。だから…やれる？
Ensemble of Hope#507.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#509.src: ...Rose. I think we can do this. I have a printing press at home.
Ensemble of Hope#509.dst: …Rose。私たちならできると思う。家に印刷機があるの。
Ensemble of Hope#509.speaker: Wilted Camellia

Ensemble of Hope#510.src: You're...C-Camellia, you're actually with me this time?
Ensemble of Hope#510.dst: あなた…C、Camellia、今回は本当に一緒に来てくれるの？
Ensemble of Hope#510.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Ensemble of Hope#511.src: Yeah. I've been saying "next time for sure" enough. It's time to put my money where my mouth is.
Ensemble of Hope#511.dst: うん。「次こそ絶対」はもう十分言った。口だけじゃなく行動で示す時よ。
Ensemble of Hope#511.speaker: Wilted Camellia

Ensemble of Hope#512.src: We'll...we'll make calling cards. Spread them around. You're good with words, and art- you can handle the design.
Ensemble of Hope#512.dst: 私たち…ビラを作ろう。あちこちにばらまくの。あなたは文章も絵も得意だから―デザインは任せる。
Ensemble of Hope#512.speaker: Wilted Camellia

Ensemble of Hope#513.src: And you'll...f-finally, we'll... I can actually... Thank you! Both of you! You can...definitely count on us!
Ensemble of Hope#513.dst: それであなたは…や、やっと、私たち…私、本当に…ありがとう！二人とも！私たちに…絶対任せて！
Ensemble of Hope#513.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Ensemble of Hope#515.src: I'm... glad there's still people willing to help. Even here.
Ensemble of Hope#515.dst: 私…まだ助けてくれる人がいてよかった。ここでも。
Ensemble of Hope#515.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#516.src: We should, um, get some rest. Before tomorrow. Come on, let's get back to the hotel.
Ensemble of Hope#516.dst: 私たち、えっと、休まないと。明日の前に。行こう、ホテルに戻ろう。
Ensemble of Hope#516.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#517.src: Get a night's sleep before the Festival day in the hotel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Ensemble of Hope#517.dst: [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] のホテルで祭りの日に備えて一晩眠る。

Ensemble of Hope#518.src: We should, um, get some rest. Before tomorrow. Come on, let's get back to the hotel.
Ensemble of Hope#518.dst: 私たち、えっと、休まないと。明日の前に。行こう、ホテルに戻ろう。
Ensemble of Hope#518.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#519.src: You are no longer welcome in this establishment.
Ensemble of Hope#519.dst: あなたはもう当店にはお越しいただけません。
Ensemble of Hope#519.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Ensemble of Hope#520.src: Turn yourself in at the gates at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Ensemble of Hope#524.src: You... you're {u}. The most wanted terrorist in the province.
Ensemble of Hope#524.dst: お前…お前は {u}。この地方で一番のお尋ね者のテロリストだ。
Ensemble of Hope#524.speaker: Capital Soldier

Ensemble of Hope#525.src: Soldiers! Don't let down you guard.
Ensemble of Hope#525.speaker: Capital Soldier

Ensemble of Hope#527.dst: あの君主が言ってたのは…
Ensemble of Hope#527.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Ensemble of Hope#528.dst: どうして彼女にそんなことが…？
Ensemble of Hope#528.speaker: Capital Soldier

Ensemble of Hope#529.src: Doesn't matter. {u}, you are under arrest for terrorism and multiple counts of first degree murder!
Ensemble of Hope#529.dst: どうでもいい。{u}、テロ行為および複数の第一級殺人の容疑で逮捕する！
Ensemble of Hope#529.speaker: Capital Soldier

Ensemble of Hope#530.src: Sovereigns. We meet here today to discuss this ongoing headache which has persisted for far too long.
Ensemble of Hope#530.dst: 君主たちよ。今日ここに集まったのは、あまりに長く続くこの頭痛の種について話し合うためだ。
Ensemble of Hope#530.speaker: Her Majesty

Ensemble of Hope#531.src: And why has it persisted, I wonder? Perhaps, could it be-
Ensemble of Hope#531.dst: はて、なぜ続いているのでしょうね？もしや、それは―
Ensemble of Hope#531.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Ensemble of Hope#532.src: Don't even start, Thalas. In fact, let me begin the summation! The simplest form of the problem is that we don't have our full numbers devoted to a solution!
Ensemble of Hope#532.dst: 言わせるか、Thalas。いや、私が総和を出す！問題を最も簡単な形にすると、解に全戦力を代入していないということだ！
Ensemble of Hope#532.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Ensemble of Hope#533.src: I fought the Cursed nearly to a standstill, and my power's only increased since then! I can divide them out if you plug me into the equation again.
Ensemble of Hope#533.dst: 私は呪われし者とほぼ互角に戦い、その後も力は増える一方だ！もう一度方程式に代入すれば、奴らを割り切ってみせる！
Ensemble of Hope#533.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Ensemble of Hope#534.src: Oh, and you're the man for the job? Behold, the oh-so-great Sovereign Zhiraok "Third time's the estimated solution" Nasin! How terrifying.
Ensemble of Hope#534.dst: おや、あなたが適任だと？ご覧あれ、偉大なる君主 Zhiraok「三度目は近似解」Nasin！なんと恐ろしい。
Ensemble of Hope#534.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Ensemble of Hope#535.src: You mindless monomial- If you want me to ennumerate on your flaws, I'll factor that in right away! Let's look at the tally!
Ensemble of Hope#535.dst: この脳なしの単項式め―欠点を列挙してほしいなら、今すぐ因数分解してやる！集計を見てみろ！
Ensemble of Hope#535.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Ensemble of Hope#536.src: Soosu messed up my calculations and let them escape, and still won't say why! And Sovereign Gikyo was divided by {~} degrees after they tried to apprehend the Cursed!
Ensemble of Hope#536.dst: Soosu は私の計算を狂わせて奴らを逃がし、理由も言わない！君主 Gikyo は呪われし者を捕らえようとして {~} 度に割られた！
Ensemble of Hope#536.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Ensemble of Hope#537.src: As if that's a loss to be mourned. Good riddance.
Ensemble of Hope#537.dst: 悼むほどの損失でもない。清々した。
Ensemble of Hope#537.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Ensemble of Hope#538.src: Now now, settle down. Yes, perhaps our ranger had their... mmm, psychotic tendencies? I certainly wouldn't have wanted to cross them on a bad day!
Ensemble of Hope#538.dst: まあまあ、落ち着いて。確かに我らが狩人には…ええ、狂気じみた傾向があったかもしれません？機嫌の悪い日には関わりたくないですね！
Ensemble of Hope#538.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Ensemble of Hope#539.src: But still, they proved a valuable asset! Who will train our changeling spies now? And how long might it take to train a replacement? Years? Dec-
Ensemble of Hope#539.dst: それでも貴重な戦力でした！これから誰がチェンジリングの密偵を鍛えるのです？後任の育成にどれほどかかるか？数年？数十―
Ensemble of Hope#539.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Ensemble of Hope#540.src: And YOU, Thalas! A TOUR! All this power and mastery you can't drop your decibels over and you use NONE of it, you factoring fraud?!
Ensemble of Hope#540.dst: そして貴様だ、Thalas！観光案内だと！デシベルを落とせぬほどの力と技を持ちながら、何一つ使わんとは、この因数詐欺師め？！
Ensemble of Hope#540.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Ensemble of Hope#541.src: It seemed unlikely they would give up their information if met with aggression. It was the preferable outcome.
Ensemble of Hope#541.dst: 攻撃的に接すれば情報を明かさない可能性が高かった。あれが望ましい結果だった。
Ensemble of Hope#541.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#542.src: Remember the order of operations? If the Cursed remains a variable here you won't be able to input that important data for your mission elsewhere- and you're overlooking an obvious angle!
Ensemble of Hope#542.dst: 演算の順序を覚えているか？呪われし者がここで変数のままでは、別の任務の重要なデータも入力できん―それに明らかな角度を見落としている！
Ensemble of Hope#542.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Ensemble of Hope#543.src: Instead of wasting the lives of our soldiers- our people- You could've gotten the info, and then used some of that "phenomenal cosmic power" while their back was turned!
Ensemble of Hope#543.dst: 兵士の命を―民の命を―無駄にするより、情報を得てから、背を向けた隙にその「驚異的な宇宙の力」を使えばよかったのだ！
Ensemble of Hope#543.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Ensemble of Hope#545.src: And Sovereign Tasim, I'm sorry to say, your prior intersections with the Cursed equal out to a conflict of interest. You've let that rogue integer go how many times now?
Ensemble of Hope#545.dst: そして君主 Tasim、残念ながら、君と呪われし者の過去の交点は利害の衝突に等しい。あのはみ出し整数をもう何度逃がした？
Ensemble of Hope#545.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Ensemble of Hope#547.src: At least your irrationality has a basis. I'd be a hypocrite to act otherwise. But your duties to the crown are more important.
Ensemble of Hope#547.dst: 少なくとも君の無理数ぶりには根拠がある。それを責めれば私も偽善者だ。だが王家への務めの方が重要だ。
Ensemble of Hope#547.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Ensemble of Hope#548.src: And has anyone else got an excuse for being so obtuse? I'm not hearing any yet!
Ensemble of Hope#548.dst: 他にこれほど鈍角な言い訳がある者は？まだ一つも聞こえんぞ！
Ensemble of Hope#548.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Ensemble of Hope#549.src: Apologies for the disruption, Sovereigns, Your Majesty. The Spymaster requested she be alerted regarding certain events.
Ensemble of Hope#549.dst: お邪魔して申し訳ありません、君主の皆様、陛下。密偵長が、特定の事態について知らせるよう求めておりました。
Ensemble of Hope#549.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Ensemble of Hope#550.src: Yes, thank you, Lord Commander. I'm afraid I'll need to take my leave for the time being. Carry on without me.
Ensemble of Hope#550.dst: ええ、ありがとう、司令官閣下。申し訳ないが、しばし席を外さねばならない。私抜きで続けて。
Ensemble of Hope#550.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#551.src: And there's my answer!! No one else has anything to say, our Spymaster can't even be bothered to share her intel, and the problem. Remains. Unsolved!
Ensemble of Hope#551.dst: それが答えだ！！誰も何も言わず、密偵長は情報を共有する気もなく、問題は。依然。未解決だ！
Ensemble of Hope#551.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Ensemble of Hope#552.src: That is enough, Sovereign Nasin! Your frustration is understandable, but-
Ensemble of Hope#552.dst: もうよい、君主 Nasin！苛立ちはわかるが―
Ensemble of Hope#552.speaker: Her Majesty

Ensemble of Hope#553.src: With all due respect, Your Majesty, we are exponentially far past frustration! A killer at large, and the objectively most well-suited person to solve the problem is...benched?!
Ensemble of Hope#553.dst: 恐れながら陛下、苛立ちなどとうに指数関数的に超えております！殺人者が野放しで、客観的に最適な者が…控えに回されている？！
Ensemble of Hope#553.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Ensemble of Hope#554.src: I've only grown stronger since my failures, and only interference stopped me the second time! No one else is suited for this, the plan is obvious-
Ensemble of Hope#554.dst: 私は失敗から強くなる一方で、二度目も邪魔が入っただけだ！他に適任はいない、計画は明白だ―
Ensemble of Hope#554.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Ensemble of Hope#555.src: Why, a plan! My, what a wonderful idea- we're finally getting somewhere! Goodness, I thought we'd never hear the end of it.
Ensemble of Hope#555.dst: なんと、計画！まあ、素晴らしいお考え―ようやく話が進みますね！やれやれ、終わらないかと思いました。
Ensemble of Hope#555.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Ensemble of Hope#556.src: Your Majesty, if the Sovereign Nasin has finally concluded his needless tirade, may I take the floor?
Ensemble of Hope#556.dst: 陛下、君主 Nasin の無用な長広舌がようやく終わったのなら、発言してもよろしいでしょうか？
Ensemble of Hope#556.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Ensemble of Hope#559.src: How wonderful. Now, as Zhiraok had just helpfully revealed, the Spymaster and I had something of a meeting with our delightfully persistent blight.
Ensemble of Hope#559.dst: 結構。さて、Zhiraok がご親切に明かした通り、密偵長と私は、あのしぶとく愛しい災いと、ちょっとした面会をしました。
Ensemble of Hope#559.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Ensemble of Hope#560.src: The details are not important- any information gleaned has already made its way to those who need it! Which would be... ah, everyone here besides Nasin! Funny how things work out, mmn?
Ensemble of Hope#560.dst: 詳細は重要ではありません―得た情報はすでに必要な方々に届いています！つまり…ああ、Nasin 以外の全員に！面白いものですね、ふふ？
Ensemble of Hope#560.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Ensemble of Hope#562.src: As for why we did not take them in, then and there? They are not the heart of this disease of rebellion. If we remove one, we only galvanize the rest.
Ensemble of Hope#562.dst: なぜその場で捕らえなかったか？彼らは反乱という病の核ではないからです。一人を除けば、残りを奮い立たせるだけ。
Ensemble of Hope#562.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Ensemble of Hope#563.src: We must carve them out in one fell swoop. To that end - our dear Spymaster had placed a tracking spell on their two lovely rescued companions.
Ensemble of Hope#563.dst: 一網打尽にせねばなりません。そのために―我らが密偵長は、救出された二人の愛らしい仲間に追跡の呪文をかけておいたのです。
Ensemble of Hope#563.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Ensemble of Hope#564.src: We know where they are hiding out, and the Wings have been stationed in wait for our signal to strike. Our enemies are cornered.
Ensemble of Hope#564.dst: 隠れ家は把握済み、翼の部隊も配置について合図を待っています。敵は袋の鼠です。
Ensemble of Hope#564.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Ensemble of Hope#565.src: Excellent work, Majin. Once this meeting has adjourned, I expect your soldiers to capture them promptly.
Ensemble of Hope#565.dst: 見事だ、Majin。この会議が終わり次第、そなたの兵にすみやかに捕らえさせよ。
Ensemble of Hope#565.speaker: Her Majesty

Ensemble of Hope#566.src: This ordeal is tiring... unfortunately, it would seem one execution has proven not to be enough.
Ensemble of Hope#566.dst: この騒ぎには疲れる…残念ながら、処刑一つでは足りなかったようだ。
Ensemble of Hope#566.speaker: Her Majesty

Ensemble of Hope#567.src: Had that brat, Soosu, not thrown her tantrum, perhaps it would have been manageable. But the people are beginning to talk. And we cannot allow such unrest.
Ensemble of Hope#567.dst: あの小娘、Soosu が癇癪を起こさなければ、まだ手に負えたかもしれぬ。だが民が噂し始めている。そのような動揺は許されない。
Ensemble of Hope#567.speaker: Her Majesty

Ensemble of Hope#568.src: We will execute the remaining dissidents at the festival, and finally rid ourselves of this lasting annoyance.
Ensemble of Hope#568.dst: 残る反逆者は祭りで処刑し、この長きにわたる煩わしさをついに断つ。
Ensemble of Hope#568.speaker: Her Majesty

Ensemble of Hope#569.src: Is that really necessary? If you can take them all captive, you've already solved the problem. It just seems-
Ensemble of Hope#569.dst: 本当に必要ですか？全員捕らえられるなら、問題はもう解決しています。ただそれは―
Ensemble of Hope#569.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Ensemble of Hope#570.src: It's simply a matter of sending a message, Sovereign. Show the public what happens to those who turn against the crown, and it dissuades them from following in those footsteps!
Ensemble of Hope#570.dst: 単に見せしめの問題ですよ、君主。王家に背いた者の末路を民に見せれば、同じ道を辿ろうとする者はいなくなる！
Ensemble of Hope#570.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Ensemble of Hope#571.src: Really, I understand you're new around here, but catch up, would you? The rest of us don't have the time or patience to wait around while you... ah, get with the program.
Ensemble of Hope#571.dst: まったく、新参なのはわかりますが、ついてきてもらえます？皆、あなたが…ああ、状況を飲み込むのを待つ暇も忍耐もないのです。
Ensemble of Hope#571.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Ensemble of Hope#574.src: Explore your cell. To return go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Ensemble of Hope#576.src: Oh. It's you. So they got you in the end, then.
Ensemble of Hope#576.dst: あ。あんたか。結局捕まったんだ。
Ensemble of Hope#576.speaker: Soosu

Ensemble of Hope#577.src: I did kinda expect that to happen. Was just looking for a way out, and... figured it'd be better to try than not.
Ensemble of Hope#577.dst: そうなるとは思ってたけど。出口を探してただけで…やらないよりはやってみた方がいいかなって。
Ensemble of Hope#577.speaker: Soosu

Ensemble of Hope#578.src: Yus still doing alright out there? Can't say I really... care about the rest of you.
Ensemble of Hope#578.dst: Yus は外で元気にしてる？他のあんたたちのことは…どうでもいいけど。
Ensemble of Hope#578.speaker: Soosu

Ensemble of Hope#579.src: Hm! Well, that's good. Good he's still got a chance at life, unlike...
Ensemble of Hope#579.dst: ふん！まあ、よかった。あの子にはまだ生きるチャンスがあるんだ、あたしと違って…
Ensemble of Hope#579.speaker: Soosu

Ensemble of Hope#580.src: ...well, s'not like I was living much anyway, so. Really, what's the difference?
Ensemble of Hope#580.dst: …まあ、どうせあたし、ろくに生きてなかったし。実際、何が違うっての？
Ensemble of Hope#580.speaker: Soosu

Ensemble of Hope#581.src: Oh, sure, she can dismantle all my golems all she wants! Take them apart piece by piece by PIECE right in front of me!!!
Ensemble of Hope#581.dst: ああそう、あたしのゴーレムを好きなだけ壊せばいい！目の前でひとつ、ひとつ、ひとつバラバラにすればいい！！！
Ensemble of Hope#581.speaker: Soosu

Ensemble of Hope#582.src: It's not like I've already DONE THAT a million times already! It's not like SHE'S the one who taught me that method of stress relief in the FIRST PLACE, noooom no no no, now it's special!!
Ensemble of Hope#582.dst: あたしがとっくに百万回もやってないみたいに！そもそもそのストレス発散法を教えたのが「あいつ」じゃないみたいに、いやいやいや、今さら特別扱い！！
Ensemble of Hope#582.speaker: Soosu

Ensemble of Hope#583.src: And so what if it is!!! SO WHAT if I had to watch Flowers fall apart BIT by little BIT!!! SO WHAT if she'll keep me STUCK here forever and ever and ever and EVER!!!
Ensemble of Hope#583.dst: だったら何なの！！！Flowers が少しずつ崩れていくのを見せられたから何！！！あいつがあたしを永遠に、永遠に、永遠にここに閉じ込めるから何！！！
Ensemble of Hope#583.speaker: Soosu

Ensemble of Hope#584.src: It's all just the same. Not alive, not dead, just STUCK!! Only this time, it's all out in the open for everyone to see.
Ensemble of Hope#584.dst: 全部同じ。生きてもない、死んでもない、ただ閉じ込められてる！！今回はそれがみんなに丸見えなだけ。
Ensemble of Hope#584.speaker: Soosu

Ensemble of Hope#585.src: So who cares. Really, who cares? Z'll run my district better than I ever did. That's all anyone cares about, anyway.
Ensemble of Hope#585.dst: だから誰が気にするの。本当に、誰が？Z ならあたしより区をうまく治める。みんなが気にするのはそれだけ。
Ensemble of Hope#585.speaker: Soosu

Ensemble of Hope#587.src: Once more we meet, {u}. Though this time, it seems you have played the first hand.
Ensemble of Hope#587.dst: また会ったね、{u}。もっとも今回は、君が先に手札を切ったようだ。
Ensemble of Hope#587.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#588.src: So, this is the path you wish to take? A risk, certainly... you cannot guarantee a favorable result.
Ensemble of Hope#588.dst: これが君の選んだ道か？確かに賭けだ…好ましい結果は保証できない。
Ensemble of Hope#588.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#589.src: Will it pay off, I wonder? Or have you thrown your life away for nothing?
Ensemble of Hope#589.dst: 報われるだろうか？それとも無駄に命を捨てたのか？
Ensemble of Hope#589.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#590.src: ...I suppose we'll find out in due time.
Ensemble of Hope#590.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#591.src: These cells are quite the marvel, aren't they? A complex netting which suppresses all magic within. It's almost like a dead zone in the Weave... but not quite.
Ensemble of Hope#591.dst: この独房は実に見事だろう？中の魔法をすべて抑え込む複雑な網だ。まるで織り目の中の死角のようだ…完全ではないがね。
Ensemble of Hope#591.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#592.src: It's remarkable work, Soosu. I'd never seen anything like it before. It has certainly proven useful many times in the decades since its invention.
Ensemble of Hope#592.dst: 素晴らしい仕事だ、Soosu。これほどのものは見たことがない。発明から数十年、何度も役に立ってきた。
Ensemble of Hope#592.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#593.src: Have you reconsidered my proposal yet? The option remains open, as always.
Ensemble of Hope#593.dst: 私の提案は考え直したか？選択肢はいつでも開かれている。
Ensemble of Hope#593.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#595.src: Hm. Well, regardless, I should inform you that Her Majesty is scheduled for another visit tonight.
Ensemble of Hope#595.dst: ふむ。いずれにせよ、伝えておこう。今夜、陛下が再びお見えになる予定だ。
Ensemble of Hope#595.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#598.src: You are very fortunate, {u}, that I'm the one here to collect you. You'll have your audience with Her Majesty.
Ensemble of Hope#598.dst: 運がいいな、{u}。迎えに来たのが私で。陛下への謁見は叶うだろう。
Ensemble of Hope#598.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#599.src: Let's see if your gamble pays off, shall we?
Ensemble of Hope#599.dst: 君の賭けが報われるか、見てみようか？
Ensemble of Hope#599.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#600.src: Follow Two and have a conversation with Her Majesty.
Ensemble of Hope#600.dst: Two についていき、女王陛下と話す。

Ensemble of Hope#603.src: Oh, for heavens' sake- Spymaster, what is the meaning of this?! Why are they here?
Ensemble of Hope#603.dst: おお、なんということ―密偵長、これはどういうことです？！なぜその者がここに？
Ensemble of Hope#603.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Ensemble of Hope#604.src: They had requested an audience with Her Majesty. A possibility which had been communicated to them prior.
Ensemble of Hope#604.dst: 女王陛下への謁見を求めていた。その可能性は以前に伝えてある。
Ensemble of Hope#604.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#605.src: What is this miscalculation?! We are all together with the murderer, they've got zero chance to win! Your Majesty, ple-
Ensemble of Hope#605.dst: 何だこの計算違いは？！全員が殺人者と一緒だぞ、奴の勝率はゼロだ！陛下、どう―
Ensemble of Hope#605.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Ensemble of Hope#606.src: Sovereign Nasin, I have just about had enough of your interruptions today. I will permit them this audience.
Ensemble of Hope#606.dst: 君主 Nasin、今日はそなたの横槍にもううんざりだ。この謁見を許す。
Ensemble of Hope#606.speaker: Her Majesty

Ensemble of Hope#607.src: You have been a thorn in my side ever since you first arrived in my province, it would seem. Quite the annoyance.
Ensemble of Hope#607.dst: そなたは我が地方に初めて来た時から、ずっと目の上のたんこぶだったようだ。実に煩わしい。
Ensemble of Hope#607.speaker: Her Majesty

Ensemble of Hope#608.src: And it would seem it is indeed your presence which has galvanized each assorted group of petulant children into action!
Ensemble of Hope#608.dst: そして、駄々をこねる子供たちの群れをことごとく動かしたのも、まさにそなたの存在らしい！
Ensemble of Hope#608.speaker: Her Majesty

Ensemble of Hope#609.src: So perhaps my dear Sovereign is right. Why should I grant you this allowance? I would be well within my right to execute you alongside your companions.
Ensemble of Hope#609.dst: ならば我が君主の言う通りかもしれぬ。なぜこの許しを与えねばならぬ？仲間もろとも処刑する権利が私にはある。
Ensemble of Hope#609.speaker: Her Majesty

Ensemble of Hope#610.src: And yet, certainly, you would prove a valuable ally in the coming days. You've proven your value in maintaining Their balance.
Ensemble of Hope#610.dst: とはいえ、この先の日々で貴重な味方となるのも確かだ。「彼ら」の均衡を保つ上で、そなたは価値を示してきた。
Ensemble of Hope#610.speaker: Her Majesty

Ensemble of Hope#611.src: But in the end, it falls on you to prove whether or not you are worth the effort. You have come here willingly, which is the first step. Now, take the second.
Ensemble of Hope#611.dst: だが結局、手間をかける価値があるかはそなた次第だ。自ら来たのは第一歩。さあ、二歩目を踏み出せ。
Ensemble of Hope#611.speaker: Her Majesty

Ensemble of Hope#612.src: Oh, I suppose it makes no difference if you know or not. Either you are aligned with us, or you are out of the picture entirely.
Ensemble of Hope#612.dst: まあ、知っていようがいまいが変わらぬか。我らにつくか、完全に消えるかのどちらかだ。
Ensemble of Hope#612.speaker: Her Majesty

Ensemble of Hope#613.src: What are we planning? To delve deep into the Dark's Claim itself, to root out the source of its added weight on the scales.
Ensemble of Hope#613.dst: 何を企てているか？「闇の領地」そのものの奥深くへ入り、天秤に加わった余分な重みの源を根絶することだ。
Ensemble of Hope#613.speaker: Her Majesty

Ensemble of Hope#614.src: It has acquired power beyond its means, and if it is not dealt with, that little parasite you killed will prove only the beginning of its conquest.
Ensemble of Hope#614.dst: 闇は分不相応な力を得た。放置すれば、そなたが殺したあの小さな寄生虫は、その征服の始まりにすぎなくなる。
Ensemble of Hope#614.speaker: Her Majesty

Ensemble of Hope#615.src: Therein lies the reason for the tournament, all those weeks ago. To select a candidate for the task. Powerful, knowledgeable, loyal.
Ensemble of Hope#615.dst: 何週間も前のあの大会は、そのためにあった。この任に就く者を選ぶため。強く、博識で、忠実な者を。
Ensemble of Hope#615.speaker: Her Majesty

Ensemble of Hope#616.src: And so, for one final time, I will give this opportunity to you. Show me whether you may be considered an asset, or if you are nothing more than the nuisance you have shown yourself to be.
Ensemble of Hope#616.dst: ゆえに、最後にもう一度だけ機会を与えよう。そなたが財産とみなせる者か、それともこれまで見せてきた通りの厄介者にすぎぬのか、示してみよ。
Ensemble of Hope#616.speaker: Her Majesty

Ensemble of Hope#617.src: How, indeed... you have cost me two of my Sovereigns thus far, have disrupted the yearly Festival rotation, and have killed dozens of my soldiers.
Ensemble of Hope#617.dst: どうやって、か…そなたはこれまでに君主を二人失わせ、毎年の祭りの巡りを乱し、我が兵を何十人も殺した。
Ensemble of Hope#617.speaker: Her Majesty

Ensemble of Hope#618.src: It is no simple task, making up for such acts. And I would require significant assurance that it will not happen again.
Ensemble of Hope#618.dst: それを償うのは容易ではない。二度と起こらぬという確かな保証も要る。
Ensemble of Hope#618.speaker: Her Majesty

Ensemble of Hope#619.src: Perhaps, the truth of the matter is that you cannot. You have cause me far, far too many problems to simply-
Ensemble of Hope#619.dst: あるいは、実のところ償うことなどできぬのかもしれぬ。そなたはあまりに多くの問題を―
Ensemble of Hope#619.speaker: Her Majesty

Ensemble of Hope#620.src: They are very simple. Denounce your allies, and allow this little rebellion to be washed away once more, as it has many times before.
Ensemble of Hope#620.dst: 条件はごく簡単だ。仲間を糾弾し、このささやかな反乱を、これまで幾度もそうだったように、再び洗い流させよ。
Ensemble of Hope#620.speaker: Her Majesty

Ensemble of Hope#621.src: You are not special, you know. The people do have the knack for rising up in such childish tantrums. But as has been proven time and time again, nothing is beyond my means to bury.
Ensemble of Hope#621.dst: そなたは特別ではない。民はこのような子供じみた癇癪で立ち上がるのが得意でな。だが幾度も証明されてきた通り、私に葬れぬものなど何もない。
Ensemble of Hope#621.speaker: Her Majesty

Ensemble of Hope#622.src: So. What will it be? Have you come to your senses? Or-
Ensemble of Hope#622.dst: さて。どうする？正気に戻ったか？それとも―
Ensemble of Hope#622.speaker: Her Majesty

Ensemble of Hope#623.src: A disappointing outcome... but not altogether unexpected. I did not think you would change your stance so quickly.
Ensemble of Hope#623.dst: 残念な結果だ…だが全く予想外でもない。そう簡単に立場を変えるとは思っていなかった。
Ensemble of Hope#623.speaker: Her Majesty

Ensemble of Hope#624.src: Truly, then, all you have done is wasted my time. And that, I am afraid I will not abide.
Ensemble of Hope#624.dst: ならば、そなたがしたのは私の時間の浪費だけだ。それは、あいにく容認できぬ。
Ensemble of Hope#624.speaker: Her Majesty

Ensemble of Hope#625.src: You will not see the light of day again, {u}. Your allies will fall, and you will not see it happen, but you will know-
Ensemble of Hope#625.dst: 二度と日の光は拝めぬぞ、{u}。仲間は倒れ、そなたはそれを目にすることもない。だが知ることには―
Ensemble of Hope#625.speaker: Her Majesty

Ensemble of Hope#626.src: Sovereigns! Your Majesty! The terrorists...they have launched an assault on the Citadel gates!
Ensemble of Hope#626.dst: 君主の皆様！陛下！テロリストどもが…城塞の門に攻撃を仕掛けてきました！
Ensemble of Hope#626.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Ensemble of Hope#627.src: And the people of {p}...they are in a panic from a dissident's proclamation...the imminent death of a Sovereign!
Ensemble of Hope#627.dst: さらに {p} の民が…反逆者の声明で恐慌状態に…君主の一人が間もなく死ぬと！
Ensemble of Hope#627.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Ensemble of Hope#628.src: ANOTHER?! I swear, if we ignore a statement of that value-
Ensemble of Hope#628.dst: また一人だと？！まったく、そんな値の声明を無視すれば―
Ensemble of Hope#628.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Ensemble of Hope#630.src: Commander, explain the situation on the way. Worry not, Your Majesty, I'll take care to ensure the fruition of our discussed plans for the festival.
Ensemble of Hope#630.dst: 司令官、道すがら状況を説明しなさい。ご心配なく、陛下。祭りの件、話し合った計画は必ず実現させます。
Ensemble of Hope#630.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Ensemble of Hope#632.src: A clever ploy, I will grant you that. But I tire of these games. You have proven yourself a waste of effort. You will be afforded no more opportunities.
Ensemble of Hope#632.dst: 巧妙な策だ、それは認めよう。だがこの遊びにも飽きた。そなたは手間の無駄だと証明した。これ以上の機会はない。
Ensemble of Hope#632.speaker: Her Majesty

Ensemble of Hope#633.src: Sovereign Two, I expect you to dispose of this problem of ours.
Ensemble of Hope#633.dst: 君主 Two、この問題の始末はそなたに任せる。
Ensemble of Hope#633.speaker: Her Majesty

Ensemble of Hope#634.src: In the meantime... it would seem the populace has forgotten who holds control in this province. Perhaps they could use a reminder.
Ensemble of Hope#634.dst: その間に…民はこの地方を誰が支配しているか忘れたようだ。思い出させてやるとしよう。
Ensemble of Hope#634.speaker: Her Majesty

Ensemble of Hope#635.src: Sovereign Zhiraok, Sovereign Tasim. I expect the two of you to join me for the festival.
Ensemble of Hope#635.dst: 君主 Zhiraok、君主 Tasim。二人とも祭りに同行せよ。
Ensemble of Hope#635.speaker: Her Majesty

Ensemble of Hope#636.dst: 私は…わかりました。はい、陛下。
Ensemble of Hope#636.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Ensemble of Hope#638.src: ...this is really where you choose to stand your ground?
Ensemble of Hope#638.dst: …本当にここで意地を張るのか？
Ensemble of Hope#638.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Ensemble of Hope#640.src: ...I hope you know what you're doing.
Ensemble of Hope#640.dst: …わかってやってるといいけど。
Ensemble of Hope#640.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Ensemble of Hope#643.src: How fortunate for you. It seems the cards keep falling in your favour.
Ensemble of Hope#643.dst: 運のいいことだ。札はいつも君に有利に落ちるらしい。
Ensemble of Hope#643.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#644.src: Do not get ahead of yourself. I am still deciding.
Ensemble of Hope#644.dst: 調子に乗るな。まだ決めかねている。
Ensemble of Hope#644.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#645.src: It would be simpler to dispose of you now. Every notion, each flaw - you have proven them true countless times over.
Ensemble of Hope#645.dst: 今始末する方が簡単だ。あらゆる推測、あらゆる欠点―君は何度もそれが正しいと証明してきた。
Ensemble of Hope#645.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#646.src: What use do I have for an unpredictable actor, when there are many more reliable options resting in the wings?
Ensemble of Hope#646.dst: 控えに信頼できる選択肢がいくらでもあるのに、予測不能な役者に何の用がある？
Ensemble of Hope#646.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#647.src: But now that you are a known variable, in your absence, it would seem the shards destabilize. Why? I cannot fathom the reason.
Ensemble of Hope#647.dst: だが君が既知の変数となった今、君がいないと、欠片が不安定になるようだ。なぜだ？理由が見当もつかない。
Ensemble of Hope#647.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#648.src: Then I am left with only one option. It is unfavorable... but I suppose it will have to do.
Ensemble of Hope#648.dst: ならば残る選択肢は一つ。好ましくはない…が、やむを得まい。
Ensemble of Hope#648.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#649.src: You will bear witness to the uncountable shards of shattered futures. You will see the coming end. And you will prove to me you are a worthwhile alternative.
Ensemble of Hope#649.dst: 砕けた未来の、数えきれぬ欠片を見届けよ。来たる終わりを見よ。そして、君が価値ある代案だと証明してみせろ。
Ensemble of Hope#649.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#650.src: Enter Two's mirror. To return go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Ensemble of Hope#652.src: Is this your reflection? Emptiness? A bottomless well where your self should be stored?
Ensemble of Hope#652.dst: これが君の姿か？虚ろ？君自身が収まるべき場所に、底なしの井戸？
Ensemble of Hope#652.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#653.src: And yet, you seem hardly affected by the lack... how peculiar. Is this the source of your strength?
Ensemble of Hope#653.dst: それでいて、その欠落にほとんど影響されていないようだ…なんと奇妙な。これが君の力の源か？
Ensemble of Hope#653.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#654.src: How very troubling. But for now... it will do nicely. Perhaps you will finally come to understand.
Ensemble of Hope#654.dst: 実に厄介だ。だが今は…これで十分だ。ようやく理解するかもしれない。
Ensemble of Hope#654.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#655.src: Explore the mirror realm. To return go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Ensemble of Hope#655.dst: 鏡の世界を探索する。戻るには [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] へ。

Ensemble of Hope#656.src: A shard. Actions taken, decisions made, and the consequences that spiral outwards on and on and on.
Ensemble of Hope#656.dst: 欠片だ。取った行動、下した決断、そして延々と外へ広がり続ける結果。
Ensemble of Hope#656.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#657.src: This should seem familiar. Will you put the pieces together?
Ensemble of Hope#657.dst: 見覚えがあるはずだ。欠片をつなぎ合わせられるか？
Ensemble of Hope#657.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#658.src: The Shade, the Neverending Night, the Darkness lurking in the deep... lying in wait for the right time to strike.
Ensemble of Hope#658.dst: 影、終わらぬ夜、深みに潜む闇…打って出る時をじっと待っている。
Ensemble of Hope#658.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#659.src: It holds the upper hand, you know. Even with your recent strikes against it. And oh, it has grown to hate you for that, hasn't it?
Ensemble of Hope#659.dst: 奴の方が優勢なのだよ。君が最近打撃を与えたとしてもだ。そして、ああ、そのせいで奴は君を憎むようになった、そうだろう？
Ensemble of Hope#659.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#660.src: Do you expect it to hold back? Its nature is to take, consume, repurpose. And it finally holds the means.
Ensemble of Hope#660.dst: 手加減すると思うか？奪い、喰らい、作り変えるのが奴の本性だ。そしてついにその手段を得た。
Ensemble of Hope#660.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#661.src: Explore the new mirror realm. To return go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Ensemble of Hope#661.dst: 新しい鏡の世界を探索する。戻るには [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] へ。

Ensemble of Hope#662.src: And another. Different actions, different decisions, yet the results remain conclusive. Mirrored, in all the ways which matter.
Ensemble of Hope#662.dst: もう一つ。違う行動、違う決断、それでも結果は変わらない。重要な点ではすべて、鏡映しだ。
Ensemble of Hope#662.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#663.src: Do you see? Do you see it now? The futility? The nigh-inevitability of the coming end?
Ensemble of Hope#663.dst: わかるか？今ならわかるか？その虚しさが？来たる終わりが、ほぼ避けられぬことが？
Ensemble of Hope#663.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#664.src: The Dawn, the Piercing Radiance, the Light which casts judgement from above. Blinding all who dare stand in its way.
Ensemble of Hope#664.dst: 暁、貫く輝き、高みから裁きを下す光。行く手を阻む者すべての目を眩ませる。
Ensemble of Hope#664.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#665.src: It plays at divinity, claims benevolence... but its nature is no different from the Shade. It will discard the pieces on the board once they no longer serve a purpose.
Ensemble of Hope#665.dst: 神を気取り、慈悲を謳う…だがその本性は影と何ら変わらない。役目を終えた盤上の駒は、容赦なく捨てる。
Ensemble of Hope#665.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#666.src: Removing one actor is not enough. Removing both is near-impossible. What option does that leave?
Ensemble of Hope#666.dst: 一方を除くだけでは足りない。両方を除くのはほぼ不可能。では何が残る？
Ensemble of Hope#666.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#667.src: Explore the new mirror realm. To return go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Ensemble of Hope#667.dst: 新しい鏡の世界を探索する。戻るには [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] へ。

Ensemble of Hope#668.src: And here, the final bitter truth. You claim to care for our province? For the people living within?
Ensemble of Hope#668.dst: そしてここに、最後の苦い真実がある。この地方を大切に思うと言うのか？そこに生きる民を？
Ensemble of Hope#668.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#669.src: Then look upon this final outcome... and do not turn your gaze.
Ensemble of Hope#669.dst: ならばこの最後の結末を見よ…目を逸らすな。
Ensemble of Hope#669.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#670.src: Through inaction, this is where the future leads. Dawn or Dusk, it matters not - all will fall to ruin.
Ensemble of Hope#670.dst: 何もしなければ、未来はここへ行き着く。暁でも黄昏でも関係ない―すべては滅びる。
Ensemble of Hope#670.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#671.src: If not Her, who would tip the scales?
Ensemble of Hope#671.dst: 「彼女」でなければ、誰が天秤を傾ける？
Ensemble of Hope#671.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#675.src: ...How long has it been, now? Years and years and years... all of it erased, destroyed, and still I remain.
Ensemble of Hope#675.dst: …もうどれほど経った？何年も、何年も…すべて消され、壊され、それでも私は残っている。
Ensemble of Hope#675.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#676.src: It was the only choice I could have made, then. Anyone else would have done the same.
Ensemble of Hope#676.dst: あの時、私にできた選択はそれだけだった。誰でも同じことをしただろう。
Ensemble of Hope#676.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#677.src: Even now, knowing what I do... would I have followed through? Would I have still...?
Ensemble of Hope#677.dst: 今でも、知っていることを知った上で…私はやり遂げただろうか？それでも私は…？
Ensemble of Hope#677.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#678.src: I should not expect answers from ghosts. If it's all to be forgotten... so be it. They're my mistakes to bear.
Ensemble of Hope#678.dst: 亡霊に答えを求めるべきではない。すべて忘れられるのなら…それでいい。私が背負うべき過ちだ。
Ensemble of Hope#678.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#679.src: ...ah. I see now my error. Very clever, traversing the shards and reaching though the fractured web into my own past.
Ensemble of Hope#679.dst: …ああ。私の誤りがわかった。見事だ、欠片を渡り、砕けた網を越えて私の過去にまで手を伸ばすとは。
Ensemble of Hope#679.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#680.src: But you are not entitled to this intrusion. And you will receive nothing more.
Ensemble of Hope#680.dst: だが、この侵入を許した覚えはない。これ以上は何も得られない。
Ensemble of Hope#680.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#683.src: A satisfactory showing. Perhaps you will manage to surprise me, after all.
Ensemble of Hope#683.dst: 満足のいく結果だ。結局、君は私を驚かせるのかもしれない。
Ensemble of Hope#683.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#684.src: Then I will leave the rest to fate. Either you live, or you die. Both outcomes will resolve favorably.
Ensemble of Hope#684.dst: では後は運命に任せよう。君が生きるか、死ぬか。どちらの結果も好ましく収まる。
Ensemble of Hope#684.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#685.src: If you are so desperate to change this province... prove it.
Ensemble of Hope#685.dst: そこまでこの地方を変えたいのなら…証明してみせろ。
Ensemble of Hope#685.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#686.src: Escape from Her Majesty's royal palace. To return go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Ensemble of Hope#686.dst: 女王陛下の宮殿から脱出する。戻るには [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] へ。

Ensemble of Hope#687.src: Talk to Rurie outside the palace at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Ensemble of Hope#687.dst: [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] の宮殿の外で Rurie と話す。

Ensemble of Hope#689.src: No time to stay and chat! Come with me.
Ensemble of Hope#689.dst: 話してる暇はない！ついておいで。
Ensemble of Hope#689.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#690.src: Follow Rurie to the safe zone at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Ensemble of Hope#690.dst: Rurie について [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] の安全地帯へ行く。

Ensemble of Hope#691.src: ...phew! Finally, some time to breathe. "Lightly defended" is perhaps an understatement... though, that's just {p} for you!
Ensemble of Hope#691.dst: …ふう！やっと一息つける。「警備は手薄」は控えめすぎたかな…まあ、それが {p} というものさ！
Ensemble of Hope#691.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#692.src: Ah... goodness. We're used to battling regional guards, or constables - perhaps a wing at most, rarely? But they simply do not compare to these gendarme.
Ensemble of Hope#692.dst: ああ…やれやれ。地方の衛兵や巡査なら慣れている―せいぜい翼が一人、それも稀にね。だがこの憲兵たちとは比べものにならない。
Ensemble of Hope#692.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#693.src: We have... learned that the hard way. Three casualties. Two foxes, and one owl.
Ensemble of Hope#693.dst: 我々は…痛い目を見て学んだよ。犠牲者は三人。狐が二人、梟が一人。
Ensemble of Hope#693.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#694.src: Preparations are in order for burial rights, but we are still deep in the operation! No time to grieve just yet.
Ensemble of Hope#694.dst: 埋葬の準備は進めているが、作戦はまだ真っ最中だ！悲しむ暇はまだない。
Ensemble of Hope#694.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#695.src: They knew the risks, as do we all. Joining the Canopy - properly, mind you, not like you did - comes with a willingness to die for the cause, if necessary.
Ensemble of Hope#695.dst: 彼らは危険を承知していた、我々皆がそうだ。樹冠に入るということは―正式にね、君みたいにじゃなく―必要なら大義のために死ぬ覚悟を持つということだ。
Ensemble of Hope#695.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#696.src: ...but enough about that! You live! Standing before me, in one piece and not entirely disintegrated! I take it all went well on your end?
Ensemble of Hope#696.dst: …だが、その話はここまで！君は生きている！五体満足で、分解されずに私の前に立っている！そちらはうまくいったんだね？
Ensemble of Hope#696.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#697.src: Excellent! You know, you were beginning to worry us a little. You were in there quite a while longer than we expected.
Ensemble of Hope#697.dst: 素晴らしい！実はね、少し心配になりかけていたんだ。思ったよりずっと長く中にいたからね。
Ensemble of Hope#697.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#698.src: However well enough it was, it would seem it was plenty good enough for our needs! So, I suppose we can write this one off as a success.
Ensemble of Hope#698.dst: どれほどうまくいったにせよ、我々の目的には十分すぎたようだ！というわけで、今回は成功と記録していいだろう。
Ensemble of Hope#698.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#699.src: Well, it could always be worse! As I mentioned- disintegration was one such proposed outcome... Fuhue really does have the strangest ideas about "fun."
Ensemble of Hope#699.dst: まあ、もっと悪いこともありえた！言ったろう―分解も想定された結末の一つでね…Fuhue の「面白い」の感覚は本当に変わっている。
Ensemble of Hope#699.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#700.src: Hm... well, I would think "not really" would mean "rotting in prison for all of time," but I suppose we have different definitions.
Ensemble of Hope#700.dst: ふむ…「あまり」なら「永遠に牢で朽ちる」ことだと私は思うが、どうやら定義が違うらしい。
Ensemble of Hope#700.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#701.src: In any case - welcome to the market square? Quite a lovely place, isn't it?
Ensemble of Hope#701.dst: ともかく―市場広場へようこそ？なかなか素敵な場所だろう？
Ensemble of Hope#701.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#702.src: We, ah... are holding some residents captive, in the hopes the crown will be less likely to go on a full offense! What with all the high-standing citizens around.
Ensemble of Hope#702.dst: 我々は、あー…住民を何人か人質にしていてね。王家が全面攻撃に出にくくなるように！何しろこの辺りは身分の高い市民ばかりだから。
Ensemble of Hope#702.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#703.src: Not to worry, though, we do not plan on hurting innocent people! Physically, at least - emotionally could not be helped, given the whole... holding hostage thing.
Ensemble of Hope#703.dst: 心配はいらない、無実の人を傷つけるつもりはないよ！少なくとも体はね―心の方は仕方ない、何しろ…人質という状況だから。
Ensemble of Hope#703.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#704.src: You'll be happy to hear we recently received word from our owls that the gates assault group has returned to {p}! We'll be working to get them in here soon.
Ensemble of Hope#704.dst: 嬉しい知らせだ、梟たちから、門の攻撃組が {p} に戻ったと連絡があった！もうすぐここへ連れてくる手はずだ。
Ensemble of Hope#704.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#705.src: What else, what else... owls are stationed on a rotation to defend the walls and keep watch. Foxes are ready to defend the front gates at a moment's notice.
Ensemble of Hope#705.dst: 他には、他には…梟は交代で城壁を守り見張っている。狐はいつでも正門を守れるよう待機中だ。
Ensemble of Hope#705.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#706.src: If you'd like a detailed schedule, you'll have to find Fuhue - it's too much information to keep hold of, personally!
Ensemble of Hope#706.dst: 詳しい日程が知りたいなら Fuhue を探してくれ―私個人には覚えきれない量でね！
Ensemble of Hope#706.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#707.src: Speaking of, the others would surely be glad to hear you're safe! Go on and tell them, would you?
Ensemble of Hope#707.dst: そうそう、君が無事だと知ったら皆きっと喜ぶ！伝えに行ってくれるかい？
Ensemble of Hope#707.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#708.src: Get an update on how things went on their end.
Ensemble of Hope#708.dst: 仲間たちの状況を聞く。

Ensemble of Hope#709.src: Well, go on! Find the others and tell them you're safe, would you?
Ensemble of Hope#709.dst: さあ、行った行った！皆を見つけて無事だと伝えておいで！
Ensemble of Hope#709.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#710.src: We need to get a plan established, and fast. Time is running out.
Ensemble of Hope#710.dst: 急いで計画を立てねばならない。時間がない。
Ensemble of Hope#710.speaker: Azael

Ensemble of Hope#714.src: Yeah? Can't say that's surprising, since... y'know. Dealing with the Queen.
Ensemble of Hope#714.dst: そうか？まあ意外じゃないな…ほら。相手が女王だし。
Ensemble of Hope#714.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#715.src: As for me... I got to join one of the Fox units. We're defending the zone from assaults from the crown!
Ensemble of Hope#715.dst: 俺の方は…狐部隊の一つに入ったんだ。王家の攻撃からこの区域を守ってる！
Ensemble of Hope#715.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#716.src: It... feels good. Finally getting to get my hands dirty, and make a difference. Yulie never would've let me do something like this before.
Ensemble of Hope#716.dst: なんか…いい気分だ。やっと自分の手で何かを変えられる。前の Yulie なら絶対こんなことさせてくれなかった。
Ensemble of Hope#716.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#717.src: ...I don't think I'd have had the courage for it, if it wasn't for Zeph.
Ensemble of Hope#717.dst: …Zeph がいなかったら、こんな勇気は出なかったと思う。
Ensemble of Hope#717.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#718.src: Like... I dunno. He barely even hesitated back in the Roughworks, before jumping in to help a random woman he didn't even know!!
Ensemble of Hope#718.dst: なんていうか…わかんねえ。Roughworks であいつ、見ず知らずの女の人を助けに、ほとんど迷わず飛び込んだんだ！！
Ensemble of Hope#718.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#719.src: And... I want to be like that, y'know! Confident enough to do that sorta thing.
Ensemble of Hope#719.dst: で…俺もああなりたいんだよ！ああいうことができる自信がほしい。
Ensemble of Hope#719.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#720.src: ...don't, uh, tell him I said all that though!! Ha. It's a little embarrassing to actually say out loud.
Ensemble of Hope#720.dst: …あ、今の、あいつには言うなよ！！はは。口に出すとちょっと恥ずかしいな。
Ensemble of Hope#720.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#721.src: You're gonna head over to him and the others soon though, right? Tell him... uh... something. That I hope he's okay? I dunno, I'll come up with something.
Ensemble of Hope#721.dst: でもこの後あいつや他のみんなのとこに行くんだろ？伝えてくれ…えっと…何か。無事でいてほしいとか？わかんねえ、考えとく。
Ensemble of Hope#721.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#722.src: Hey, have you talked to Azael yet? He's in the command center they've set up in the bank.
Ensemble of Hope#722.dst: なあ、Azael とはもう話したか？銀行に作った司令部にいるぞ。
Ensemble of Hope#722.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#723.src: Oh, {u}, you're alright! That's a relief.
Ensemble of Hope#723.dst: お、{u}、無事だったか！ほっとした。
Ensemble of Hope#723.speaker: Yulie

Ensemble of Hope#724.src: I'd ask you for more details... but somehow I've ended up with responsibilities here. Sigh.
Ensemble of Hope#724.dst: 詳しく聞きたいところだけど…なぜかここで責任を負わされちまってさ。はあ。
Ensemble of Hope#724.speaker: Yulie

Ensemble of Hope#725.src: I've been trying to help Fuhue keep the owl units on schedule... but, DAMN!
Ensemble of Hope#725.dst: Fuhue を手伝って梟部隊を時間通りに回そうとしてるんだが…くそっ！
Ensemble of Hope#725.speaker: Yulie

Ensemble of Hope#726.src: Why is everything so precise?! The current squad needs to switch out at... exactly {~}:{~}! Why?! Who needs this level of specificity?!
Ensemble of Hope#726.dst: なんで全部こんなに細かいんだ？！今の班の交代は…ちょうど {~1}:{~2}！なんで？！誰がこんな精度を求めてるんだ？！
Ensemble of Hope#726.speaker: Yulie

Ensemble of Hope#727.src: ...have you talked to Azael and Quill yet? I think they were waiting for news about you, in the bank.
Ensemble of Hope#727.dst: …Azael と Quill とはもう話したか？銀行であんたの知らせを待ってたと思う。
Ensemble of Hope#727.speaker: Yulie

Ensemble of Hope#728.src: Oh, not now. UGH! Where did those deers put today's evening rations?!
Ensemble of Hope#728.dst: ああ、今はだめ。もう！鹿たちは今夜の配給をどこに置いたの？！
Ensemble of Hope#728.speaker: Fuhue

Ensemble of Hope#730.dst: 殺されなかったのね。よかった。
Ensemble of Hope#730.speaker: Fuhue

Ensemble of Hope#731.src: Hm? No. Simply stating an observation.
Ensemble of Hope#731.dst: え？違う。事実を言っただけ。
Ensemble of Hope#731.speaker: Fuhue

Ensemble of Hope#733.src: Either way. I had the deers bring rations and quipment with us, but in the chaos it seems they have not followed my established sorting system! Everything is a mess.
Ensemble of Hope#733.dst: とにかく。鹿たちに配給と装備を運ばせたけど、混乱の中で私の決めた分類方式を守らなかったみたい！何もかもめちゃくちゃ。
Ensemble of Hope#733.speaker: Fuhue

Ensemble of Hope#734.src: And now not only do I need to maintain schedules for the foxes and owls, because Rurie is a mess, but I also have to find where our supplies are!
Ensemble of Hope#734.dst: しかも Rurie がだらしないせいで狐と梟の日程管理までしなきゃいけないのに、物資の在りかまで探す羽目に！
Ensemble of Hope#734.speaker: Fuhue

Ensemble of Hope#735.src: At least Yulie has offered to help keep track of the owls' movements. That's one less thing to worry about.
Ensemble of Hope#735.dst: せめて Yulie が梟の動きの管理を手伝うと言ってくれた。心配事が一つ減った。
Ensemble of Hope#735.speaker: Fuhue

Ensemble of Hope#736.src: I need to get back to finding tonight's food supplies. Maybe you can go be useful elsewhere?
Ensemble of Hope#736.dst: 今夜の食料探しに戻らないと。どこか他で役に立ってきたら？
Ensemble of Hope#736.speaker: Fuhue

Ensemble of Hope#737.src: ... You could try telling Master Azael you're alive. He'll be in the command station in the bank.
Ensemble of Hope#737.dst: …Azael 様に生きてると伝えてきたら。銀行の司令部にいらっしゃるから。
Ensemble of Hope#737.speaker: Fuhue

Ensemble of Hope#738.src: Y'know, it's nice to finally get a break from guarding for a bit! I've been at it for hours...
Ensemble of Hope#738.dst: なあ、やっと見張りから少し休めていいもんだ！何時間もやってたからな…
Ensemble of Hope#738.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#739.src: Sigh... it's nearly time for the next unit rotation. Talk to you later.
Ensemble of Hope#739.dst: はあ…そろそろ次の班の交代だ。また後でな。
Ensemble of Hope#739.speaker: Yulie

Ensemble of Hope#741.src: Talk to the leaders in the bank at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Ensemble of Hope#743.src: Not yet, I am afraid. The festival will be starting within an hour or so, though...
Ensemble of Hope#743.dst: 残念ながら、まだだ。だが祭りはあと一時間ほどで始まる…
Ensemble of Hope#743.speaker: Azael

Ensemble of Hope#745.src: Ah, how wonderful! You have survived. That makes three of four teams now accounted for.
Ensemble of Hope#745.dst: おお、素晴らしい！生き延びたか。これで四組のうち三組の無事が確認できた。
Ensemble of Hope#745.speaker: Azael

Ensemble of Hope#746.src: Yes... it would seem the owls are struggling to get ahold of group {~}.
Ensemble of Hope#746.dst: ああ…梟たちが第 {~} 組と連絡を取れずにいるようだ。
Ensemble of Hope#746.speaker: Azael

Ensemble of Hope#747.src: We did, shortly after the attack. But since then, owls have been struggling to make contact. They should have arrived at the hotel, but...
Ensemble of Hope#747.dst: 攻撃の直後には取れた。だがその後、梟たちが接触に苦労している。ホテルには着いているはずなのだが…
Ensemble of Hope#747.speaker: Quill

Ensemble of Hope#748.src: I'm starting to worry... I know we don't have instant communication, but even still, it's been a while...
Ensemble of Hope#748.dst: 心配になってきた…すぐに連絡が取れないのはわかってるけど、それでもだいぶ経つし…
Ensemble of Hope#748.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#749.src: Hmm. Military activity has increased drastically ever since we took control. We know the owls are struggling to move from here to {p}.
Ensemble of Hope#749.dst: ふむ。我々がここを押さえてから軍の動きが激増した。梟がここから {p} へ移動するのに苦労しているのはわかっている。
Ensemble of Hope#749.speaker: Azael

Ensemble of Hope#750.src: It could be something, or it could very well be nothing. There is little we can do but wait.
Ensemble of Hope#750.dst: 何かあったのかもしれないし、何もないのかもしれない。待つ以外にできることはほとんどない。
Ensemble of Hope#750.speaker: Azael

Ensemble of Hope#751.src: Master Azael! Oh, ah, and others- news have arrived from the owls!
Ensemble of Hope#751.dst: Azael 様！おっと、皆さんも―梟たちから知らせが届いた！
Ensemble of Hope#751.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#752.dst: 良い知らせか、悪い知らせか？
Ensemble of Hope#752.speaker: Azael

Ensemble of Hope#753.src: Bad, I fear. There's quite the commotion in {p} - the streets are crawling with soldiers, and the people of the city have been gathered on the festival grounds.
Ensemble of Hope#753.dst: 残念ながら悪い方だ。{p} で大騒ぎになっている―通りは兵士だらけで、街の人々は祭りの会場に集められている。
Ensemble of Hope#753.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#754.src: Ahead of schedule... do we know which Sovereigns are present?
Ensemble of Hope#754.dst: 予定より早い…どの君主がいるかわかるか？
Ensemble of Hope#754.speaker: Quill

Ensemble of Hope#755.src: Thalas, naturally. And likely the Queen as well, given the circumstances.
Ensemble of Hope#755.dst: Thalas は当然。状況からして、女王もいる可能性が高い。
Ensemble of Hope#755.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#756.src: Damn it... we need to get people to {p}! Our- our friends, they're-
Ensemble of Hope#756.dst: くそ…誰かを {p} に送らないと！僕の―僕らの仲間が―
Ensemble of Hope#756.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#757.src: Yes, we must, but I cannot afford to leave my position here... and I don't believe we can spare any of our fighters...
Ensemble of Hope#757.dst: ああ、行かねばならない。だが私はここの持ち場を離れられないし…戦士を割く余裕もないと思う…
Ensemble of Hope#757.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#758.src: Ah! Yes, that will do. Come, I'll show you the way out of the citadel.
Ensemble of Hope#758.dst: ああ！そう、それでいこう。おいで、城塞の出口まで案内する。
Ensemble of Hope#758.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#759.src: {u}... good luck. We- aah- we cannot afford to lose any more of our people. Get them back to us safely...
Ensemble of Hope#759.dst: {u}…幸運を。我々は―うっ―これ以上仲間を失うわけにはいかん。無事に連れ帰ってくれ…
Ensemble of Hope#759.speaker: Quill

Ensemble of Hope#761.src: Use this tunnel - it'll bring you near the entrance of the citadel. When you're done, use it from the other side to get back to us...
Ensemble of Hope#761.dst: このトンネルを使って―城塞の入口近くに出られる。済んだら反対側から入って戻っておいで…
Ensemble of Hope#761.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#762.src: ...though, ah, take care not to let any of the crown's soldiers follow you through? I'm not sure we can afford the stress!
Ensemble of Hope#762.dst: …ただし、ああ、王家の兵士に後をつけられないように頼むよ？そんな心労には耐えられそうにない！
Ensemble of Hope#762.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#763.src: We're nearing the end, just got to stick the landing. Now, go get 'em!
Ensemble of Hope#763.dst: 終わりは近い、あとは見事に着地するだけだ。さあ、やっつけておいで！
Ensemble of Hope#763.speaker: Rurie
